rules: Five stages weighted equally at20% each.
Dataset audit means identity/schema/labels/splits verified; it does not certify complete image availability.
Training and validation stages use completed epochs divided by the registered run budget, and become1 if training legitimately ends early.
Final stage requires selected-checkpoint final test, original numerical evidence and archived results.
Pilot progress never counts as full-cohort train/validation/test completion.
Percentages measure workflow checkpoints, not accuracy, percent of dataset processed or predicted remaining time.
Headline text bar refers to BERT baseline; additional model comparisons are separate.
Three-modality overall progress uses equal modality weights; display rounded integer percentages and exact stage states.
If tensor recovery is older than observed training history, training-stage fraction uses verified recoverable epoch/batch progress; original validation observations are retained separately.
